about: What each runtime feature is and which round scenes check it (parallax-readers:r28). tools/readers-health/health.py reads it for the dashboard's feature table: per reader, the verdicts of these scenes (libGDX: its browser cases, matched by name in core's JUnit results). A new feature, or a round scene that checks one, is named here: a feature with no scene shows as 'no round'. Kept apart from round.json because core/test-data/*/make_round.py rewrite those. scenes: round folder -> scene ids, or '*' for every scene. tickets: the mother board's, shown as parallax:rNN; format: the page format that brought it. cases: [Cases class under core/browser-test/cases, a regex its case names must match, or null for all].

features.name: Layers, tiling and the camera
features.about: IMAGE layers tiled X, Y, XY or not at all, mirrors, flips, pads, trimmed regions, gradients, resizes, a zoomed camera

features.name: Transfert (cross-fade)
features.about: one page cross-fading into another, the depth stagger, a second transfert interrupting the first

features.name: Tint
features.about: addColorTransfert: the page tinted toward a colour over time

features.name: Pixel art
features.about: an atlas filtered Nearest drawn sharp, and cross-faded with a Linear one, each keeping its filter

features.name: EMPTY layer and hooks
features.about: an EMPTY layer: the game's LayerHook called per tile in its place

features.name: PARTICLES layer
features.about: an engine's own particle effect between the layers, anchored to the view or the layer

features.name: SHADER effects (WAVE, FOG, SWELL)
features.about: a layer drawn through an effect shader, written three times line for line

features.name: SEQUENCE layer
features.about: a cycle of segments drawn from a seed, integers only

features.name: Page fog
features.about: fogStrength and fogColor: each layer mixed toward the fog by its depth

features.name: FLOOR layer
features.about: one image drawn as rows, each at its depth, MODE7 or LINE_SCROLL, the layers in front planted on it

features.name: Tower
features.about: an IMAGE layer wrapped round a cylinder in the view's middle

features.name: Tower seen from close by
features.about: towerCamera: the courses arc, the slower layers wrapped round it as panoramas

features.name: Planet
features.about: planetRadius: the page wrapped round one centre under the view

features.name: Dolly
features.about: a game's switch: each layer at its own zoom by its depth (never stored)

features.name: LURKER layer
features.about: a figure that appears or vanishes only while nothing of it is on screen

features.name: Animated patch
features.about: frames of a layer's moving part drawn over each tile

features.name: Glint
features.about: glintStrength: a SHADER layer's crests lit in pieces, after its effect

features.name: MIRROR effect
features.about: SWELL, then the water a mirror of its page's sky

features.name: Detail levels
features.about: OFF, MEDIUM or HIGH, per layer if the game likes (never stored)

features.name: Transfert: dissolve
features.about: each slot masked by drifting noise patches

features.name: Transfert: through a colour
features.about: the slots graded toward a colour and back

features.name: Transfert: fog creep
features.about: the far layers sinking into a mist first

features.name: Rings: the page round a 3D world
features.about: each layer an open cylinder round a 3D world at its depth, its band at the elevations the page gives it, the gradients by elevation (parallax-readers r35, r47, docs/page-as-3d-sky.md): core's ParallaxRings numbers, compared as JSON by tools/compare-rings.py
